questions.stem: A 62-year-old female achieved menopause with smooth transition. She is on hormone replacement therapy. She developed abdominal pain. On examination, a right adnexal mass was palpable and non-tender. On ultrasound, a 3 X 3 cm cyst in her ovary was noted. What is the next best step?
